about: Victorian house kit parts (neighborhood/props/house_parts.py). Blender z-up house space, exported y-up.
assembly: Take every part whose width is the spec's (or null) and whose `when` matches the spec (any condition; each condition: every key's value is in its list); a mirrorable part whose `when_mirror` matches is used (again) mirrored: scale x by -1 and flip each triangle's winding. Merge per material (PALETTE, GLOW). To match the baked GLBs, move the merged mesh so its bounding box's base centre is the origin.

rules.reason: a right turret takes the front-right corner: needs the left porch
a left turret takes the front-left corner: needs the right porch
a wing would hit the cross gable's end
the wrap-around porch takes the left side
the right wing takes the right wall the bay would sit on
the left wing takes the left wall the bay would sit on
the cross gable already fills the slopes
the hip's front gable takes the dormer's spot
the right wing's roof would hide the side dormer
the balcony needs a centred porch roof under the front gable
the balcony needs a centred porch roof under the front gable

roles.rule: sRGB colour = min(1, palette[role] * k) per channel; linear vertex colour = srgb ** 2.2

colours_note: a spec's `colours` (role -> hex) override its palette preset; brick siding defaults the body to brick_body

glow.note: emissive, never a light or transparent; not recoloured by palettes

kid_spot.note: in front of the door on the porch deck, Blender z-up house space
